name: spec
description: 读取用户原始需求与 context-summary.md，套用 spec_template.md 生成 spec.md。spec.md 只描述 What / Why 与验收，不写技术方案；用户确认后方可进入 Planning。

prompt.instruction: Fill the spec_template with concrete content derived from the user's original requirement (the prompt that triggered this skill, available in session context) and context-summary.md (supporting evidence). Replace every {{ placeholder }} with project-specific text or remove the surrounding section if not applicable. Number every functional requirement (e.g., FR-CTX-1, FR-SPEC-1) so they are addressable from later stages (plan / test-plan / tasks). Append the standard '## 用户确认' section at the end.
guardrails: Do not include any implementation choice — no library names, no frameworks, no file paths inside source code. That belongs to plan.md.
Every functional requirement must have a unique stable ID.
Open Questions section is mandatory; defer all unresolved decisions there to be answered in plan.md.
Preserve user-supplied terminology verbatim; do not paraphrase domain terms.
